verdict.rationale: Docs confirm applicants have profiles showing check results (e.g., Liveness section) and reviewers can manually approve/reject regardless of status, implying a review workflow with evidence, and webhooks propagate status changes back to the record. However, there is no explicit description of a dedicated 'manual review queue' UI, extracted field display, or how reviewer decisions feed back into re-scoring/orchestration logic. Missing for 10: dedicated review-queue UI documentation, extracted-field presentation details, explicit feedback loop into verification level/orchestration.
